title: Surveyor's Brass Theodolite
summary: Hal's frostbitten apprentice dropped three brass survey stakes and a sighting glass in the frozen gorges before the sentinels woke. Recover the kit so Thornwick can map the pass.
objectives: Recover the brass sighting glass in the west gorge
Collect both iron-shod survey stakes in the east defile
Return the survey kit before lighting the Twin Cairns
accept_line: My apprentice ran when the rocks started walking—grab that brass glass before the snow buries it.
complete_line: Not a dent on the lens! Here's your silver; now we can draw an honest road map.

title: Locked Miners' Paychest
summary: Blood-cultists barricaded an old dwarven shift-office off the second gallery where three months of miners' silver still sits under a rune-bolt.
objectives: Take the rune-key off the cultist warden in gallery two
Unlock the dwarven shift-office door
Clear the cultists guarding the iron paychest
accept_line: That silver belongs to miners' widows in Ashbrook, not blood-chanting maniacs.
complete_line: Seal's unbroken. Take your cut—the rest goes straight back to the widows' ledger.

title: Relief Valves on the Cliff
summary: Even after the ward-rings crack, trapped steam could burst Oakhaven's lower cistern pipes unless three bronze pressure valves are cranked open.
objectives: Open the western cliff relief valve
Crank the central cistern vent wheel
Release the eastern basalt pressure valve
accept_line: Wrap wet wool over your hands too—those bronze wheels will take the skin right off your palms.
complete_line: Hear that whistle? Pipes won't burst now. Oakhaven owes you a dry cellar.

title: Break the Signal Mirrors
summary: Hidden spotters perched along Split Tooth's flanks flash polished tin mirrors to guide arbalest volleys onto advancing infantry.
objectives: Smash the west ridge signal mirror
Clear the spotter perch above the coastal road
Shatter the east granite signal post
accept_line: Every glint on that granite means another volley in our teeth. Smash their tin.
complete_line: No more flashes from the crags—their arbalest crews are shooting blind now.

title: Salvage the Apothecary Cart
summary: An overturned supply cart in the drizzle holds Sera's last crates of laudanum and clean linen bandages, right where raider hounds are prowling.
objectives: Fight through the hound pack in the south bracken
Recover the strapped laudanum crate
Haul the linen bandage bales back to the chapel
accept_line: Sixty men on wooden planks and I'm down to torn shirts—fetch that cart before the rain ruins it!
complete_line: Dry linen and full bottles. Half these lads will keep their legs thanks to you.

title: Drowned Chart-Room
summary: Before the lower ward floods chin-deep, Pilot Venn wants the reef soundings locked inside the Sunken Citadel's sea-level chart-room.
objectives: Force the swollen oak door of the lower chart-room
Retrieve the oiled-leather reef charts
Escape the lower ward before the tide rises
accept_line: Those soundings show every hidden fang between here and Harborwatch—grab them before the sea does!
complete_line: Oiled leather kept the ink crisp. Our ships won't tear their keels out now.

title: Quivers on the Canyon Trail
summary: Lyra's relief runners were cut down along the canyon track, leaving three iron-bound bolt chests scattered behind the roadblocks.
objectives: Recover the bolt chest behind the first deadfall
Reclaim the quiver bundle near the canyon bend
Deliver the quarrels to Iron-Gate Watchtower
accept_line: Fourteen bolts won't hold a goat-pen—if you spot my runners' chests on the way up, bring every shaft!
complete_line: Two hundred steel bodkins! Tell the raiders to come try the gate again.

title: Cap the Hidden Spring
summary: Even with their cisterns low, High-Orchard's garrison sneaks water-bearers down a wooded gully to an old stone springhouse after dark.
objectives: Clear the water-bearers guarding the gully
Collapse the springhouse culvert with a powder charge
Block the wooded path back to the redoubt
accept_line: Cut off the mules and plug their secret spring—thirst will open that gate faster than rams.
complete_line: Not a drop left for their kettles. They'll be chewing dry chalk by supper.

title: The Bridge-Warden's Ledger
summary: The riverlock's turncoat warden collected three seasons of bridge tolls in an iron chest bolted inside the western toll-booth.
objectives: Breach the western toll-booth iron door
Slay the turncoat toll-collector
Confiscate the bridge-warden's strongbox
accept_line: He taxed our own supply wagons twice over—go audit his strongbox while the gears are jammed.
complete_line: Heavy with silver pennies and forged receipts. That'll pay for fresh bridge timber.

title: Shatter the Anchor Pylons
summary: Three ancient rune-pylons along the pine ridge feed slow regeneration into the Elder Juggernaut's anthracite core.
objectives: Smash the west ridge binding pylon
Topple the moss-covered center rune-stone
Destroy the east cliff anchor pylon
accept_line: Those pylons keep knitting its granite seams back together—crack them and the beast stays cracked!
complete_line: The hum in the pine needles just died. Now hit its furnace core before it cools.

title: Burn Vane's Debt Writs
summary: Baron Vane keeps a box of signed debt-writs in his study, holding dozens of coastal shipwrights hostage to his treason.
objectives: Force the door to Vane's upper manor study
Seize the iron-bound debt-writ coffer
Burn the writs in the manor hearth
accept_line: Gold buys sellswords, but paper owns shipwrights. Torch those writs before Vane slips away.
complete_line: Nothing left in the grate but black curl and melted wax. The shipwrights owe Vane nothing.

title: Reclaim the Stolen Cannon-Parts
summary: Among the harbor salvage the two mercenary bands are fighting over are three bronze trunnions meant for Oakhaven's seawall.
objectives: Secure the salvage crate on the northern mudbank
Recover the bronze trunnion from the eastern camp
Tag the third crate in the hollow for haulage
accept_line: Those idiots are bashing skulls over bronze gun-mounts they don't even know how to cast!
complete_line: All three trunnions accounted for. Harborwatch's seawall batteries will bark again.

title: Save the Unfinished Brig
summary: A half-planked brig sits in Harborwatch's drydock as burning pitch-pots rain down; cutting its keel-chocks will slide it into safe water.
objectives: Clear the pitch-throwers on the drydock catwalk
Cut the port-side keel-chocks
Knock free the starboard launch wedges
accept_line: Six months of seasoned oak on those blocks—knock the wedges loose before Kael's fire catches her!
complete_line: She hit the water with a hiss and not a scorch on her ribs! Best launch I ever saw.

title: Mark Safe Paths in the Ash
summary: Sulfur crust hides boiling steam vents across the black glass sand; planting iron trail-poles will save the main baggage train.
objectives: Plant a marker pole past the western sulfur sink
Drive a stake along the central glass ridge
Set the final trail-marker below Highcrest bluff
accept_line: One wrong step on that yellow crust boils a horse to the hock. Mark the solid stone for the wagons.
complete_line: Three iron poles standing tall against the ash. The main column can march without losing a mule.

title: Salvage the Copper Conductors
summary: Heavy copper grounding rods driven beside each crag beacon can be pried loose to shield our sappers against static traps ahead.
objectives: Pry the copper rod from the west beacon crag
Recover the grounding spike on the north ridge
Collect the third copper conductor by the east prism
accept_line: Pure drawn copper is worth its weight in gold up here—pull those spikes once the prisms crack!
complete_line: Still warm from the lightning, and not a pit in the metal. Our sappers will thank you.

title: Haul Quicklime to the Breach
summary: Greystone's curtain wall is crumbling to gravel; hauling three barrels of quicklime-grout to the parapet will keep the gate-arch standing.
objectives: Roll the first grout barrel up the west stair
Deliver quicklime to the cracked center parapet
Reinforce the eastern gatehouse arch
accept_line: Pumice dust won't hold an arch—get that quicklime up the steps before the next boulder lands!
complete_line: Sets hard as iron in this heat. The wall will hold long enough for you to burn their engines.

title: Malrik's Scattered Folios
summary: Running blind up Ashveil Gorge, Malrik shed three lead-cased leyline folios behind his jagged obsidian barricades.
objectives: Recover the folio behind the lower obsidian wall
Reclaim the lead case in the middle gorge
Collect the third codex near the portal stairs
accept_line: He stole those folios from Oakhaven's vault—pick up every page he drops in the ash!
complete_line: All three lead cases intact. Now we can read the Citadel's wards before we knock.

title: Flood the Ley-Salt Magazines
summary: Even after the mana-cannons are spiked, their underground ley-salt magazines could detonate and collapse the citadel causeway.
objectives: Douse the ley-salt casks under the west crag
Ruin the powder-salt stores in the east bunker
Collapse the magazine vent shaft
accept_line: One stray spark in those magazines and the causeway goes into the chasm—soak the casks!
complete_line: Turned to grey sludge. Those bronze cannons won't bark again this century.

title: Extract the Lodestone Cores
summary: The animated iron golems patrolling the canyon carry fist-sized lodestone cores that can demagnetize our vanguard's blades.
objectives: Pry the core from the first gate's iron golem
Recover the lodestone heart in the canyon narrows
Claim the third core before the final portcullis
accept_line: Half my lads can't draw a dagger straight in this canyon—bring me those golem cores!
complete_line: Reverse the poles and the pull drops to nothing. Now our steel swings true again.

title: Choke the Magma Feeders
summary: Two basalt sluice-gates feed fresh molten rock into the Citadel moat; dropping their iron portcullises will cool the crossing.
objectives: Drop the western magma feeder gate
Jam the eastern slag-channel shutter
Clear the fire-tenders guarding the moat wall
accept_line: Cut the feed and that moat crusts over black in minutes—drop those iron shutters!
complete_line: Glow's fading fast. Even if a plank slips, nobody's boiling today.

title: Cut the Relief Signal Flags
summary: Three ash-plain watch-towers coordinate the converging relief armies with colored smoke pots; blinding them buys precious time.
objectives: Topple the northern signal scaffold
Smash the western smoke-pot brazier
Burn the eastern relay tower
accept_line: Blind their signalers and those three armies will march right past each other in the ash!
complete_line: No more colored smoke on the horizon—their generals are fighting with blindfolds on.

title: Read the Threshold Steles
summary: Four obsidian steles ring the geometric nave, recording the true price paid by the last ruler who walked through either colossal door.
objectives: Transcribe the silver-star stele on the west wall
Inspect the liquid-fire tablet on the east plinth
Read the central oath-stone behind the praetor line
accept_line: Don't step through either door blind—read what the builders carved into the obsidian first!
complete_line: Grim reading, Commander. Whatever threshold you pick, at least you go in with open eyes.

title: Steady the Marble Resonators
summary: Three cracked marble chimes beneath the vault dome stabilize the leyline alignment so the Crown of Order doesn't shatter the altar.
objectives: Clear shadow praetorians from the north chime
Bind the cracked west resonator with silver wire
Strike the south chime as the leylines align
accept_line: If those chimes crack under the starlight, the whole dome comes down on our heads!
complete_line: Clear as winter ice. Set the Crown—the vault will hold.

title: Smother the Oath-Braziers
summary: Four iron oath-braziers around the Obsidian Throne vent fresh sulfur gas into the chamber, feeding Ashkarath's flames.
objectives: Tip the northwest sulfur brazier into the trench
Smother the northeast gas vent with slag-sand
Cap both southern throne-room braziers
accept_line: Choke those four vents and Ashkarath loses half the fire in this room—smother them!
complete_line: Air's clearing already! Now finish the First Warden before the throne cools.
